summary: This note describes Santa's Little Helper, the pet greyhound of the Simpsons family. He first appeared in the episode "Simpsons Roasting on an Open Fire" as a race dog adopted by Homer and Bart and has been in the series since. Though usually well-behaved, he can sometimes be vicious, and Bart loves and cares for him deeply despite initially being angered by a female dog giving birth to puppies.
